name: SWI/SNF related BAF chromatin remodeling complex subunit ATPase 2

function.text: SMARCA2 encodes SWI/SNF-related matrix-associated actin-dependent regulator of chromatin subfamily A member 2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to intellectual disability-sparse hair-brachydactyly syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include SWI/SNF complex-deficient undifferentiated carcinoma of the GI tract / pancreas. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
